If Granddad were here, he'd never stand for running away. Plus, that damn Denji is in Division 4... Next time, I'll rip out his heart!

You're the only one... who doesn't have a human heart anymore. If you have any semblance of a human conscience left... how about you let us kill you without a fight?
Katana Man (real name unknown), known officially as Samurai Sword サムライソード Samurai Sōdo, is a Devil-human Hybrid who merged with the Katana Devil 刀の悪魔 Katana no Akuma. His grandfather was the Debt Collector killed by Denji and because of that, he teamed up with Akane to get revenge on Denji and steal his heart.

In the Public Safety Saga, he serves as the titular main antagonist of the Katana Man arc and a minor antagonist in the Control Devil arc.

Katana Man later returns in the Academy Saga as a supporting character, having temporarily joined Public Safety as a member of Tokyo Special Division 7 with the personal agenda of reviving his grandfather's Yakuza syndicate and killing his arch-nemesis Denji.

beats.text: Katana Man arc A sudden assault on Special Division 4 leaves the surviving members disoriented, confused, and thirsty for revenge.

beats.title: Summary
beats.text: Katana Man knocks Aki back, showing confusion over Aki's plan. Aki calls out the Devil to "Finish Him", revealing it to be the Curse Devil. As the Devil states "0", a massive disembodied hand is shown to grab Katana Man. He briefly expresses shock, before being torn limb-from-limb by the giant skeletal devil. He falls to the floor, unconscious and bleeding profusely.

beats.title: Plot points introduced
beats.text: Katana Man, Haruka, Nobana, and Seigi are taken prisoner by Public Safety. Denji finally discovers who Yoru is after she reveals her role as the War Devil. Yoru informs Denji what will happen on the day when the Death Devil descends. Various high-ranking Devils will greet Death once she lands on Earth, including the Fire Devil. The Control Devil may show up but not as the same person Denji once knew before. Yoru makes a proposal that if Denji manages to defeat the Death Devil, then he can have sex with her. Should he fail, Yoru will instead turn him into a weapon and confront Death by herself.

beats.title: Synopsis / Public Safety Saga / Katana Man arc
beats.breadcrumb: Synopsis / Public Safety Saga / Katana Man arc
beats.text: Aki draws out a spike with a sword hilt and engages Katana Man. Katana Man is stabbed three times in a row by Aki which summons the Curse Devil. The Curse Devil grabs Katana Man and violently kills him.(Chapter 24, Episode 8) Akane Sawatari appears in the ruined building and crouches down near Katana Man, reviving him. As Aki watches in shock, Katana Man tells Sawatari that he underestimated his opponent, and prepares to use his special technique. Crouching down with his blade arms at his side, Katana Man dashes forward with his blades outstretched, creating a large tear through Aki's chest that fatally wounds him.(Chapter 24, Episode 8)

beats.title: Personality
beats.text: Katana Man is a selfish, cruel-hearted, stubborn, and rather unintelligent man who only cares about killing Denji and forcing him to apologize for killing his grandfather. He will sacrifice innocent people and even his own comrades to do so, being willing to cut through them just to get to Denji.(Chapter 26, Episode 9) He has shown a complete disbelief in Denji's excuse that he killed his grandfather because he was a zombie and accused Denji of being a liar.(Chapter 36, Episode 12)

beats.title: Summary
beats.text: Katana Man attacks Denji and they fly off the building and onto the roof of a nearby building. They proceed to fight from rooftop to rooftop until Denji falls on a train. Katana Man jumps on it too and states that Denji has become faster and wonders what he is fighting for. Denji states it’s to protect the life he has now. They keep on fighting and eventually fall inside the train, which stops due to the commotion they cause. Katana Man takes a stance that Denji recognizes, but sees a woman next to him. He tries stopping the Katana Man, but Katana Man doesn't stop and cuts Denji's arm. He then takes the stance once more and cut Denji's other arm. Katana Man states that Denji can no longer fight and asks him to apologize for killing his grandfather before he dies. Denji stands up, saying he can still fight as he has a chainsaw on his head. He rushes at Katana Man, who again takes his stance and the two exchange blows. Katana Man then asks Denji if his grandfather didn't teach him when to quit. In that moment, Denji's head chainsaw breaks. He asks him once again to apologize for his grandfather. Denji states Katana Man aimed as expected for his head, but that was stupid. In that moment, Katana Man splits in two. Denji then asks Katana Man if his grandfather didn't teach him that a beast should never trust a hunter. As Katana Man falls defeated in two, Denji reveals he turned his right leg into a chainsaw.

beats.text: Katana Man denies this and proceeds to complain about Chainsaw Man and his followers. While this happens, the Nail Fiend continues mocking his partner for being completely delusional about the Yakuza being Japan's heroes. Takagi intervenes and reminds the two of their duty. Before the duo can attack, Asa manages to convince them to form a truce as her group is planning to fight Chainsaw Man. The two Devil Hunters contemplate upon hearing Asa's words.
